name: @mafk/desktop
description: MAFK-24/7 Retail-Flow POS - Windows/desktop shell (Electron). Client only: it connects to the API server.
author: MAFK-24/7

scripts.start: pnpm run setup && pnpm --filter @mafk/web run build && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.dist:win: pnpm --filter @mafk/web run build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm --filter @mafk/web run build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.json
